description: Responsive card grid for discrete content objects — posts, features, team members. Not for decorative icon grids. Cards are 1-col mobile, 2-col tablet, 3-col desktop.

id.description: Optional HTML id attribute for anchor linking (e.g. navigation anchors).

title.description: Section heading above the grid. Omit if the context makes it clear.

title_accent.description: Optional exact substring of title to render in an accent color. Must match title exactly (case-sensitive) or it is ignored.

eyebrow.description: Optional short kicker/label rendered as a pill above the title.

subheading.description: Optional supporting line below the title.

heading_align.description: Alignment of the eyebrow/title/subheading header block. 'start' = left-aligned (default, unchanged historical behavior). 'center' = centered.

layout.description: Structural layout. 'cards' = standard card grid. 'steps' = numbered process cards with visual connectors at desktop. Use 'steps' for How-it-works / process flows.

theme.description: Background color/tone. Independent of layout. 'default' = page background. 'dark' = surface background with borders. 'inverted' = inverted background for strong contrast.

items.description: Array of card items. Each: { title, text, bullets, image_url, link_url, link_text }. When layout is 'steps', also include: { number }.

number.description: Step number label (e.g. '1', '01', '1.'). Required when grid layout is 'steps'.

text_role.description: Optional typography role for the card text: 'mono' (code), 'meta' (captions), 'label', or 'kicker' (eyebrow). Adds a .text-<role> class. Invalid/absent → default body text. Set via update_component. 'meta'/'kicker' also set a preset text color; an explicit --grid-item-text-color style slot overrides that preset color at ALL breakpoints (the explicit slot always wins), while the role's size/weight/letter-spacing/transform still apply.

bullets.description: Optional checklist lines rendered below text, each prefixed with a check mark. Plain text only — no HTML/markdown; each line is escaped independently. Use for scannable feature/benefit lists instead of cramming items into one text sentence.

image_alt.description: Alt text for the card image. Leave empty only if the image is purely decorative.

style.description: Optional per-card style overrides for THIS card only (issue 306). Accepts ONLY the CARD-SCOPED style slots — the ones flagged item_eligible in styling.style_slots because they are consumed on the .grid__item and its contents (issue 323): --grid-card-bg, --grid-card-border, --grid-card-border-width, --grid-card-radius, --grid-card-shadow, --grid-card-bar-color, --grid-card-bar-height, --grid-featured-texture-color, --grid-featured-shadow, --grid-card-padding, --grid-card-gap, --grid-item-title-size, --grid-item-title-color, --grid-item-text-color, --grid-bullet-color, --grid-link-color, --grid-step-color. Validated by the shared style engine exactly like grid-level slots (unknown slot names and invalid values are rejected). Rendered as inline custom properties on this card's .grid__item, so a per-card slot overrides the grid-level value by cascade proximity. Container/heading slots (--grid-bg, --grid-gap, --grid-heading-*, --grid-heading-accent-color, --grid-eyebrow-*, --grid-subheading-*, --grid-padding-*) are read on the section/list/header, not the card, so a per-card override would render nothing — they are REJECTED here with invalid_style_slot naming the card; set those on the grid-level style instead. Use per-card style for one distinct card in a row: a dark CTA panel beside light checklist cards, or a green-on-dark terminal card. Set via the composition (update_component / update_composition / create_page), not style_component (which is component-scoped).

--grid-padding-top.description: Top padding of the grid section

--grid-padding-bottom.description: Bottom padding of the grid section

--grid-heading-accent-color.description: Color of the title_accent substring within the heading, if set

--grid-eyebrow-radius.description: Eyebrow pill corner radius. Set a large value (e.g. 999px) for a fully rounded pill.

--grid-eyebrow-border-width.description: Eyebrow pill border width. Set a non-zero width (with --grid-eyebrow-border-color) for an outlined pill; 0 (default) renders no border.

--grid-eyebrow-border-color.description: Eyebrow pill border color. Takes effect when --grid-eyebrow-border-width is non-zero.

--grid-subheading-margin-bottom.description: Space between the subheading and the content below it

--grid-heading-margin-bottom.description: Space between the heading and the subheading below it

--grid-heading-max-width.description: Heading maximum width — increase to let long headings use available horizontal space

--grid-card-shadow.description: Card box shadow / glow (preset var(--shadow-sm|md|lg) or a bounded box-shadow)

--grid-card-bar-color.description: Card top-bar color or gradient (cards layout only; no bar exists on steps). The featured first card defaults to an accent gradient; setting this slot pins one bar color on every card

--grid-card-bar-height.description: Card top-bar height (cards layout only; the featured first card defaults to 4px). 0 removes the bar on every card

--grid-featured-texture-color.description: Texture-stripe line color painted on the featured first card only (cards layout on composed pages). transparent removes the stripe

--grid-featured-shadow.description: Box shadow of the featured first card only (cards layout on composed pages); overrides the shared --grid-card-shadow there. When both are unset a built-in blue glow renders. Set none (or set --grid-card-shadow for all cards) to remove the featured glow

--grid-bullet-color.description: Checklist bullet marker color (grid card bullets)

--grid-step-color.description: Step badge background color (steps layout); the number text always renders in --color-bg for contrast

dark-showcase.description: Dark background with light cards for product showcase

dense-cards.description: Tight card spacing for compact layouts

uniform-cards.description: Neutralize the featured first-card treatment for a uniform row: removes the top bars, the featured texture stripe, and the featured glow, and pins one shared border, background, shadow, and title size on every card. Residual differences that stay: the faint texture on cards 2+, a 0.25rem body padding-top difference on card 1 at desktop, and the dark-theme lift
